items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: He wrote all arrangements, you see, I played first, Sales played third, second, and third, fourth, it was real nice.

ctx.x: There were four of us playing the lead, single string, and his brother played the comp, the chords, it was good. He wrote all arrangements, you see, I played first, Sales played third, second, and third, fourth, it was real nice. I mean, we'd write on different numbers, it was real good. Sales is a good writer, he can rewrite some nice stuff.
